packageRules.description: pytest-homeassistant-custom-component is welded to one Home Assistant core version: its own PR, and a human merges it, because moving Home Assistant usually means moving the companion pins below by hand to the versions that core release requires.

Companions pinned to what the harness's Home Assistant core requires (hassil and the intents come from the conversation integration's manifest): they move with the harness, by hand, never to their own latest release.
